title: Land Mobile Radio Infrastructure Maintenance and Support
description: Description Notice of Intent to Sole Source 1. Procurement Office Background The Mission and Installation Contracting Command - Yuma Proving Ground (MICC-YPG), on behalf of the U.S. Army Yuma Proving Ground (USAYPG), Yuma, Arizona, is conducting market research to identify potential sources capable of meeting the requirement described herein. This notice is issued to attempt to bolster government and industry coordination and partnership, as well as to determine if any other qualified commercial entities possess the capabilities to fulfill this requirement. 2. Scope of Requirement & Sole Source Intent The Government intends to award a Firm-Fixed Price (FFP) contract on a sole-source basis to Motorola Solutions, Inc. (809 Pinnacle Dr Ste G, Linthicum Heights, MD, 21090-2535). USAYPG currently operates an aging, proprietary Motorola Land Mobile Radio (LMR) network system (P25 digital system) manufactured by Motorola Solutions, Inc. This requirement is for the procurement of infrastructure maintenance and support subscription services, which include: Advanced Services & Cyber Support: 24/7/365 remote technical support provided via Motorola�s secure Operations Center. Diagnostics & Restorations: Real-time network management tools and OEM-level diagnostics capable of identifying, resolving, and restoring operations during critical system failures. Advanced Repair & Return (ARR): Quick-turnaround hardware repair and return services for proprietary LMR parts and components. On-line Technical Support: Tier-3/4 technical escalations beyond the capabilities of YPG organic personnel. Due to the proprietary nature of the P25 digital system and the significant Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) resources required for configuration management and information assurance, the government has determined that only Motorola Solutions, Inc. can provide these required sustainment services. This ensures that the network configuration remains in full compliance with Information Assurance requirements in accordance with Department of Defense Instruction (DoDI) 8500. 3. Information Sought (Capability Statement) If your firm possesses the capability to meet or exceed these requirements, the Government requests that you submit a Capability Statement demonstrating your technical and operational capacity. Please address the following inquiries in your response: OEM Support & Technical Capability: Describe your company's technical capability to provide 24/7 remote support, complex diagnostics, and physical parts repair/return for an aging proprietary Motorola P25 LMR network system. OEM Partnership & Authorization: Identify whether your firm is an authorized service provider or partner of Motorola Solutions, Inc., and clarify if your firm has the necessary agreements to utilize proprietary OEM diagnostics, software patches, and configuration tools. Information Assurance (DoDI 8500): Detail your technical approach to ensuring the LMR system remains in full compliance with DoD Information Assurance requirements under DoDI 8500. Commerciality: Does your company believe this infrastructure maintenance and support subscription service is a commercial item/service under FAR Part 12? NAICS Suitability: Do you agree that NAICS code 811210 (Communication Equipment Repair and Maintenance Services) is the most appropriate classification for this acquisition? If not, please propose an alternative NAICS code with justification. Socioeconomic Status & Business Size: Identify your business size standard under NAICS 811210 (e.g., Small Business, 8(a), HUBZone, Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business, Women-Owned Small Business, or Large Business). Acquisition Approach: Identify whether your firm is interested in competing for this requirement as a Prime Contractor, or if you would pursue a subcontracting, joint-venture, or teaming arrangement. THIS REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) IS SOLELY FOR INFORMATION AND PLANNING PURPOSES. It does not constitute a Request for Proposals (RFP), Request for Quotes (RFQ), or a promise to issue a solicitation in the future. The Government is not seeking proposals at this time and will not accept unsolicited proposals. Responders are advised that the U.S. Government will not pay for any information or administrative costs incurred in response to this RFI; all costs associated with responding will be solely at the interested party�s expense. The Government is interested in input from the small business community across all socioeconomic categories (including 8(a), Small Disadvantaged Business, HUBZone, SDVOSB, and WOSB) to identify their capabilities in meeting the requirement at a fair market price. Any information received will be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed contract based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. NAICS Details Proposed services are classified under NAICS code 811210 - Communication Equipment Repair and Maintenance Services with the Corresponding index entry Communication Equipment Repair and Maintenance Services (Size Standard: $34.0M). This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in repairing and maintaining communications equipment without retailing new communications equipment, such as commercial two-way radios, cellular/mobile phones, and carrier-line transmission equipment. Attachments: Draft Performance Work Statement (PWS)

title: F108--620-26-206 Asbestos Abatement
description: The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Network Contracting Office (NCO) 2, intends to issue Solicitation 36C24227R0010 for Project 620-26-206 Asbestos Abatement at Montrose VA Medical Center, 2094 Albany Post Rd, Montrose, NY 10548. This notice is for pre-solicitation purposes only and is issued to provide advance notice of the Government's intent to solicit this construction requirement. This notice is not a request for quotes, proposals, or bids, and no contract award will be made as a result of this announcement. The official solicitation is anticipated to be posted on or about November 6, 2026, on SAM.gov, at which time all solicitation documents, including the Statement of Work, drawings, specifications, and proposal submission instructions, will be made available. This procurement is anticipated to be issued as a 100% Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) set-aside. Eligible SDVOSBs are encouraged to submit an offer upon release of the solicitation. All prospective offerors must be currently registered in www.sam.gov, www.dnb.com (Duns and Bradstreet) and be registered and verified as a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) in https://search.certifications.sba.gov/ at the time of offer submission and before award of this procurement. The applicable NAICS Code is 562910 with a small business size standard of $25.0 million. The Magnitude of Construction for this project is between $100,000 and $250,000. Scope of Work: The Montrose VA Medical Center anticipates awarding a construction contract for asbestos abatement in the Building 3 Physical Therapy/Sleep Study area. The project involves asbestos abatement within an approximately 2,300-square-foot area, including approximately 100 square feet of radiator heat shielding. Work includes the removal and proper disposal of friable and non-friable asbestos-containing materials (ACM), associated demolition, utility modifications, and site restoration as required by the contract drawings and specifications. The Contractor shall furnish all necessary labor, materials, equipment, supervision, and services to complete the work in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local regulations, including VA safety and infection-control requirements and New York State asbestos-abatement regulations. Work may require evening or weekend operations to minimize disruption to facility occupants. Period of Performance: The period of performance for Abatement shall be 365 days from Notice to Proceed (NTP). All other details and information shall be contained in the solicitation which shall be posted on www.sam.gov. The response submittal address, date and time will be included in the solicitation

title: SB ERS MATOC, USACE Northwestern Division and EPA Region 2
description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Kansas City District is procuring a Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC) for Environmental Remediation Services (ERS) in support of United States Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Northwestern Division (NWD) and the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Region 2. The MATOC will be procured on a competitive basis as a total small business (SB) set-aside under North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code 562910 Environmental Remediation Services. The scope of the SB ERS MATOC includes in-situ thermal remediation, in-situ chemical oxidation, and other chemical stabilization of contamination; operations and maintenance of remediation systems including large scale groundwater treatment plants, soil vapor extraction systems, and air sparge systems; preparation of work plans; studies with associated reports; multiple phases of field investigations; preliminary assessments; site inspections and remedial site inspections; remedial investigations; feasibility studies; Engineering Evaluation Cost Analysis; monitoring well installation and sampling; short and long term monitoring/long term operations or Long Term Response Action (LTRA); data management; data interpretation; engineering evaluation and corrective actions; optimization studies; ground-water modeling; geophysical surveys; remediation cost estimates; management of non-hazardous and hazardous investigative derived waste; environmental and human health risk assessments; risk based remediation; air emission issues including vapor intrusion; surface water discharge; applying for environmental permits; remedial design; well abandonment; meetings; public meeting participation; preparation of presentation material both written and visual; hydrological, sediment and soil studies; project reports; engineering support and/or design; value engineering studies; operations and maintenance for hazardous, toxic, and radioactive waste (HTRW) sites; energy evaluations for remediation systems; remedial action plans; remedial actions; removal action plans; removal actions; construction support; site closeout/decision documents; abandoned mines program support; and future project programming and scheduling support. The solicitation will be made available no earlier than 15 days after this presolicitation notice. All responsible sources may submit a proposal in response to the solicitation, which the government will consider in the award decision. This notice does not constitute a commitment on the part of the Government to award a contract, nor to pay for any costs incurred as a result in replying to this notice. This notice should not be construed as a commitment by the Government for any purpose.

description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Kansas City District is procuring a Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC) for Environmental Remediation Services (ERS) in support of United States Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Northwestern Division (NWD) and the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Region 2. The MATOC will be procured on a competitive basis as a total small business (SB) set-aside under North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code 562910 Environmental Remediation Services. The scope of the SB ERS MATOC includes in-situ thermal remediation, in-situ chemical oxidation, and other chemical stabilization of contamination; operations and maintenance of remediation systems including large scale groundwater treatment plants, soil vapor extraction systems, and air sparge systems; preparation of work plans; studies with associated reports; multiple phases of field investigations; preliminary assessments; site inspections and remedial site inspections; remedial investigations; feasibility studies; Engineering Evaluation Cost Analysis; monitoring well installation and sampling; short and long term monitoring/long term operations or Long Term Response Action (LTRA); data management; data interpretation; engineering evaluation and corrective actions; optimization studies; ground-water modeling; geophysical surveys; remediation cost estimates; management of non-hazardous and hazardous investigative derived waste; environmental and human health risk assessments; risk based remediation; air emission issues including vapor intrusion; surface water discharge; applying for environmental permits; remedial design; well abandonment; meetings; public meeting participation; preparation of presentation material both written and visual; hydrological, sediment and soil studies; project reports; engineering support and/or design; value engineering studies; operations and maintenance for hazardous, toxic, and radioactive waste (HTRW) sites; energy evaluations for remediation systems; remedial action plans; remedial actions; removal action plans; removal actions; construction support; site closeout/decision documents; abandoned mines program support; and future project programming and scheduling support. The solicitation will be made available no earlier than 15 days after this presolicitation notice. All responsible sources may submit a proposal in response to the solicitation, which the government will consider in the award decision. This notice does not constitute a commitment on the part of the Government to award a contract, nor to pay for any costs incurred as a result in replying to this notice. This notice should not be construed as a commitment by the Government for any purpose.

The US Air Force needs an updated Fuel System (FS), Flight Display System (FDS), and Flight Computer due to obsolescence and is looking for innovative ideas to not only replace but improve these systems with turn-key solutions enabling supportability and future growth. title: F108--620-26-206 Asbestos Abatement
description: The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Network Contracting Office (NCO) 2, intends to issue Solicitation 36C24227R0010 for Project 620-26-206 Asbestos Abatement at Montrose VA Medical Center, 2094 Albany Post Rd, Montrose, NY 10548. This notice is for pre-solicitation purposes only and is issued to provide advance notice of the Government's intent to solicit this construction requirement. This notice is not a request for quotes, proposals, or bids, and no contract award will be made as a result of this announcement. The official solicitation is anticipated to be posted on or about November 6, 2026, on SAM.gov, at which time all solicitation documents, including the Statement of Work, drawings, specifications, and proposal submission instructions, will be made available. This procurement is anticipated to be issued as a 100% Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) set-aside. Eligible SDVOSBs are encouraged to submit an offer upon release of the solicitation. All prospective offerors must be currently registered in www.sam.gov, www.dnb.com (Duns and Bradstreet) and be registered and verified as a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) in https://search.certifications.sba.gov/ at the time of offer submission and before award of this procurement. The applicable NAICS Code is 562910 with a small business size standard of $25.0 million. The Magnitude of Construction for this project is between $100,000 and $250,000. Scope of Work: The Montrose VA Medical Center anticipates awarding a construction contract for asbestos abatement in the Building 3 Physical Therapy/Sleep Study area. The project involves asbestos abatement within an approximately 2,300-square-foot area, including approximately 100 square feet of radiator heat shielding. Work includes the removal and proper disposal of friable and non-friable asbestos-containing materials (ACM), associated demolition, utility modifications, and site restoration as required by the contract drawings and specifications. The Contractor shall furnish all necessary labor, materials, equipment, supervision, and services to complete the work in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local regulations, including VA safety and infection-control requirements and New York State asbestos-abatement regulations. Work may require evening or weekend operations to minimize disruption to facility occupants. Period of Performance: The period of performance for Abatement shall be 365 days from Notice to Proceed (NTP). All other details and information shall be contained in the solicitation which shall be posted on www.sam.gov. The response submittal address, date and time will be included in the solicitation

PROCEDURES:The contractor shall prepare and maintain Quality Control Documentation, test and repair procedures, and inspection procedures which shall be made available to the Government for review and approval. The procedures shall include sequential diagrams of the test, repair, and inspection process, as well as the performance spcifications to perform the procedures. QUALITY ASSURANCE PROGRAM PLAN: The contractor shall develop, implement and maintain a Repair Quality Plan in compliance with the requirements of Mil-I-45208A, Mil-Q-9858, ISO,9000 / 9001 / 9002, or equvalent.The plan shall define the specific methods by which compliance with contractual requirements will be assured. All quality assurance data shall be provided to the Government for review and approval upon request. PURCHASED MATERIAL CONTROL: The contractor shall establish and maintain a system of control over purchased material which shall assure that the necessary requirements of this contract are included. in all sub contract agreements. A parts control system shall establish a record of performance for each purchased and internally manufactured part and shall be used to evaluate continued use of the source. The contractors control system shall be in compliance wil either Mil-I 45208A/Mil-Q-9858 or equivalent Quality Quality Assurance Standared.(ISO/AS:9000, 9001, 9002). RECEIVING INSPECTION OF PURCHASED MATERIAL: Purchased items shall be inspected upon receipt at the contractors facility to assure conformance with all requirements of the Technical Data Package (TDP). Evidence of such inspections shall be maintained for Government review at least twelve (12) months following acceptance of the end item. Inspection reports shall be maintained by the contractor. The inspection report shall, at a minimum, include a record of all dimensional data (coordinate/positional), material, finish, and process with appropriate pass/fail criteria, such ascertifications, and actual dimensional readings. FAILURE ANALYSIS AND CORRECTIVE ACTION:All failure analysis and corrective action reports/plans shall be submitted to the Government. NONCONFORMING MATERIAL:The contractor shall establish an effective system for controlling nonconforming material including procedures for identification, segregation, and disposition. CONTRACTOR INTERNAL REVIEW BOARD (IRB):IRB authority is delegated to the contractor for this contract only. The IRB may be used only for disposition of materials exhibiting minor non-conformances, scrap or rework to return a part to conformance with drawings or specifications as authorized by the approved repair procedures.IRB shall not use "AS-IS" disposition. A complete file of IRB actions shall be maintained for review by the Government for concurrance of classification. MATERIAL REVIEW BOARD (MRB):Formal MRB authority for disposition of "AS-IS"and for minor non-conformances is retained by the Government. The contractor shall submit the appropriate request for Variance via the DCMC to the NAVSUP Contracting Officer. RESPONSIBILITY FOR COMPLIANCE: All items must meet all requirements of this Statement of Work. The inspection requirements set forth in this SOW shall become part of the contractors overall inspection system or quality program. The absence of any inspection requirements in the SOW shall not relieve the contractor of the responsibility of assuring that all Government equipment submitted for acceptance comply with all requirements. Sampling in quality conformance does not authorize submission of known defective items, either indicated or actual, nor does it commit the procuring activity to acceptance of any defective items. REPAIR ASSESSMENT TESTING: The Government may select samples of the Contract Line Items (CLINS) which have completed repair and have been accepted by the Government representative for the purpose of conducting performance testing, environmental testing, and quality conformance examination in a repair assessment test program. A quantity of CLIN's may be randomly selected from each quaterly repair production completion for shipment to the CFA or other Government designated location to conduct this testing. RECORDS OF DATA COLLECTION: The contractor shall maintain a historical record file to contain copies of applicable data and documents for individual CLIN's and assemblies by CLIN serial number. The historical record file shall include,but not be limited to the following types of historical records: Receipt inspection documentation. Repair shop travelers or repair cards. Parts replacement records. Parts inspection data before and after repair as applicable. Acceptance test data. QA personnel shall maintain a complete receipt inspection,test, repair re-test, history card for each item processed. This information shall be made available to the Government upon request. 4. title: Callao, Peru Infrastructure Modernization - U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) � Latin America and Caribbean District (SAA)
description: ****SOURCES SOUGHT FOR MARKET RESEARCH PURPOSES ONLY**** This announcement seeks information from industry which will be used for preliminary planning purposes. No proposals are being requested or accepted with this announcement. THIS IS NOT A SOLICITATION FOR PROPOSALS AND NO CONTRACT SHALL BE AWARDED FROM THIS SYNOPSIS. NO SOLICITATION, SPECIFICATIONS OR DRAWINGS ARE AVAILABLE AT THIS TIME. 1. AGENCY: United States Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Latin America and Caribbean District (SAA) 2. NAICS: 236220 - Commercial and Institutional Building Construction 3. PLACE OF PERFORMANCE: Peru 4. ACQUISITION INFORMATION: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Latin America and Caribbean District (SAA), is issuing this Sources Sought announcement as a means of conducting market research to identify parties having an interest in and the resources to support a potential future design-build construction project at the Callao Naval Base, Lima, Peru. The result of this market research will contribute to determining the method of procurement. Estimated Magnitude of Construction: Between $25,000,000 and $50,000,000. Performance Period: 540 days after Notice to Proceed. Anticipated Award Date: Fiscal Year 2027 Quarter 3 Small Business Programs: In accordance with FAR 19.000(b)(1)(ii), the Procuring Contracting Officer (PCO) has elected not to apply FAR Part 19 (Small Business Programs) to this overseas procurement. Consequently, small business set-asides will not be utilized for this project in Peru. However, all responsible sources�including both U.S. concerns (large and small) and foreign entities�are encouraged to submit responses to this Sources Sought notice. 5. ANTICIPATED ACQUISITION STRATEGY: The acquisition strategy for this requirement will be determined based on the responses to this Sources Sought notice and other market research. The Government is considering several compliant acquisition pathways to ensure the successful delivery of this complex Design-Build project in Peru. All interested firms are strongly encouraged to submit a comprehensive capabilities statement, as the information received will be critical in determining the final method of procurement. The primary anticipated strategy is a Two-Phase Design-Build procurement under the authority of FAR Part 36.3. In this scenario, the Government would issue a public Phase 1 solicitation requesting offeror qualifications. Based on these qualifications, the Government would down-select the most highly qualified firms (typically no more than five) who would then be eligible to compete in Phase 2 and submit detailed technical and price proposals. However, based on the unique challenges of performing complex construction in Peru, the Government is also considering the following alternative strategies: Option 1: Limited Competition under FAR Part 6, Other Than Full and Open Competition. If market research reveals that only a very limited number of sources possess the unique combination of Design-Build expertise, mandatory Peruvian licensing (Registro Nacional de Proveedores - RNP), and demonstrated experience with specialized facilities (e.g., POL, medical, secure warehouses) in the local market, the Government may justify limiting competition. Option 2: Establishment of a Qualified Bidders List (QBL) under FAR Part 9.2. If the operational environment in Peru and the specialized nature of the requirement warrant it, the Government may decide to establish a formal Qualification Requirement. Under this authority, the Government would create a list of pre-qualified firms that demonstrate the essential standards for technical capability, financial stability, and in-country operational capacity. description: U.S. Army Combat Capabilities Development Command � Armaments Center (DEVCOM-AC), Munitions Engineering Technology Center (METC), Explosives Integration Branch FCDD-ACM-EW at Picatinny Arsenal, NJ, is conducting market research to determine the ability to manufacture and produce Pentolite. IF A SOLICITATION IS RELEASED, IT WILL BE SYNOPSIZED ON THE GOVERNMENT-WIDE POINT OF ENTRY (GPE). IT IS THE RESPONSIBILITY OF POTENTIAL OFFERORS TO MONITOR THE GPE FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION PERTAINING TO THIS REQUIREMENT.� REQUIREMENT: Pentolite is a sensitive secondary HE very often used for NOL (Naval Ordinance Laboratory) Large and Extra-Large Scale Card Gap Tests (LSGT & ELSGT). AOP-7 and DoW specifications require that materials be qualified via these tests before being considered for use in any DoW items.. Similar, lower-grade material is manufactured by other sources for commercial mining and blasting operations. It is feasible for one of these facilities to accept a DoW contract for the higher-grade material required. title: Finland – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Kuntotutkimukset
description: Helsingin kaupungin asunnot Oy (Heka) kilpailuttaa konsultit kuntotutkimuksien ja -arvioiden laadintaan. Kohteet, joihin tutkimuksia tilataan, ovat yleensä peruskorjausiässä. Kuntotutkimukset ja -arviot tilataan pääsääntöisesti erilaisten rakennusten korjaushankkeiden suunnittelun lähtötiedoiksi. Lisäksi Heka voi tilata tehtyjen tutkimusten täydennystutkimuksia. Vuosittain osa-aluekohtaiset kuntotutkimustarpeet voivat vaihdella paljon. Kuntotutkimuskokonaisuuden sisältö, laajuus ja tavoitteet määritetään kutakin yksittäistä hanketta varten erikseen. Kuntotutkimuksen tekijältä odotamme vahvaa ammattitaitoa kuntotutkimuksien ja -arvioiden laadinnasta eri aikakausien rakennuksiin, pätevyyttä tehdä tilattavia tutkimuksia ja noudattaa kyseessä olevan tutkimuksen RT- korttia tai muuta virallista ohjeistusta. Hankinta on jaettu kahteentoista osa-alueeseen. Osa-alue 1: Yleinen kuntoarvio Osa-alue 2: Salaojatutkimus Osa-alue 3: Asuinrakennuksen kuntotutkimus Osa-alue 4: Haitta-ainekartoitus Osa-alue 5: Märkätilojen kosteustutkimus Osa-alue 6: Lämmitys-, vesi- ja viemärijärjestelmän tutkimus Osa-alue 7: Ilmanvaihtojärjestelmän tutkimus Osa-alue 8: Radonmittaus Osa-alue 9: Kanava- ja hormitutkimus Osa-alue 10: Sähkö- ja tietojärjestelmätutkimus Osa-alue 11: Lämpökuvaus Osa-alue 12: Tiiviysmittaus Tavallisten vuokra-asuntojen lisäksi Hekalla on liiketiloja ja noin 50 erityisasuntokohdetta (liite erityisasuntokohteet). Lisätietoa kohteista löytyy Hekan verkkosivuilta: https://www.hekaoy.fi/kohteet/tutustu-kohteisiimme/. Hankinta toteutetaan puitejärjestelynä, jossa valitaan enintään kolme konsulttiyritystä per osa-alue. Sopimuskausi on kaksi (2) vuotta ja sopimuksen optiovuoden 1 + 1 vuotta.

title: FY27 Communications and Networking Applied Research Announcement for Office of Naval Research
description: The purpose of this announcement is to focus attention of the scientific community on (1) the area to be studied, and (2) the planned timetable for the submission of white papers and full proposals. The goal of the Communications and Networking Program within the Office of Naval Research (ONR 311) is to support the Navy's Information Warfare vision by developing measurable advances in technology that can directly enable and enhance end-to-end connectivity and quality-of-service for mission-critical information exchange among widely dispersed naval, joint, and coalition forces. The vision is to provide high throughput robust communications and networking to ensure all warfighters � from the operational command to the tactical edge � have access to information, knowledge, and decision-making necessary to perform their assigned tasks. The ONR program is interested in white papers for potential FY27 Applied Research (Budget category 6.2) projects under the following focus areas: Development of long-range VHF-band data link, using compact 4x4 Multiple-Input, Multiple-Output (MIMO) based on 5G/Commercial-Off-The Shelf (COTS) and sub-MHz frequency channelization (spectral efficiency in excess of 1 bit/Hz); Novel design and prototyping of compact electronically-steered apertures for higher frequencies (i.e., above Ka-band); Innovative approaches and technologies for low probability-of-detection communications against advanced electronic threats; Advanced techniques for distributed network control, synchronization, and/or scheduling; and New algorithms for predicting network behavior/performance or emerging operational requirements that are translated into traffic engineering policies. The ONR is receptive to innovative ideas, which are not within the above focus areas, but nonetheless are important to the Navy/Marine Corps communications and networking, as otherwise described in this Topic Description

NO REIMBURSEMENT WILL BE MADE FOR ANY COSTS ASSOCIATED WITH PROVIDING INFORMATION IN RESPONSE TO THIS ANNOUNCEMENT OR ANY FOLLOW-UP INFORMATION REQUESTS. THIS IS A FOLLOW ON FOR A DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY (DHS) STRATEGIC SOURCING CONTRACT VEHICLE, TO BE AWARDED AND ADMINISTERED BY THE U. S. COAST GUARD. AT THIS TIME THE POTENTIAL NUMBER OF MULTIPLE AWARD IDIQ CONTRACTS TO BE PUT IN PLACE TO COVER THE AREA OF RESPONSIBILITY HAS NOT BEEN DETERMINED. IT IS ANTICIPATED TO BE SIMILAR TO THE EXISTING CONTRACT VEHICLE WITH FIVE UNRESTRICTED AND FOUR SMALL BUSINESSES. The synopsis and any subsequent amendments will be available at no charge online at https://sam.gov. The successful offerors will provide professional engineering and environmental services to support USCG shore infrastructure, real property, and other projects. title: RFI Lupus Research Program (LRP) Public
description: The Congressionally Directed Medical Research Programs (CDMRP) seeks feedback to inform potential future Lupus Research Program (LRP) focus areas and associated research funding opportunities. Although fiscal year 2027 (FY27) funds have not been appropriated, the LRP is requesting this information to support program planning processes. The CDMRP wants to hear from all audiences, interested parties, and individuals from academia, industry, community and non-profit organizations, scientific and professional organizations, federal agencies, and the public. This RFI is for information and planning purposes only and should not be construed as a solicitation or an obligation on the part of the LRP or the Department of War. BACKGROUND: The CDMRP represents a unique partnership between the U.S. Congress, the military, and the public to fund innovative and impactful medical research in targeted program areas. The CDMRP LRP�s vision is to cure lupus through partnership of scientists, clinicians and persons affected by lupus. The LRP�s mission is to fund research to understand, prevent, and diagnose lupus and to improve treatments and quality of life of patients, including Service Members and their Families, Veterans and the general public. Appropriations for the LRP from FY17-24 and FY26 totaled $75 million. As of October 2026, FY27 funds for the LRP have not been appropriated. If appropriated, the CDMRP will utilize its two-tier review process https://cdmrp.health.mil/about/2tierRevProcess) to efficiently manage the LRP. Additional information about the LRP can be found here: https://cdmrp.health.mil/lrp/ RESPONSE INSTRUCTIONS: Please provide responses to this RFI by clicking on the following link: https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/FY27-LRP-RFI

description: Notice to Quoters DESCRIPTION OF REQUIREMENTS The Defense Logistics Agency Energy (DLA Energy), as the Department of War (DoW) Integrated Material Manager (IMM) for Aerospace Energy products and related services, requires the delivery of Liquid Nitrogen to Keyport, WA into a Government-owned tank. THIS IS A MARKET RESEARCH TOOL BEING USED TO IDENTIFY POTENTIAL SMALL BUSINESSES (INCLUDING, 8(A) FIRMS, WOMEN-OWNED SMALL BUSINESSES, SERVICE-DISABLED VETERAN OWNED SMALL BUSINESSES, HUBZONES) AND LARGE BUSINESS FIRMS CAPABLE OF PERFORMING THESE CONTRACTS IN ANY OF THE 50 UNITED STATES AND IT�S TERRITORIES. NO REIMBURSEMENT WILL BE MADE FOR ANY COSTS ASSOCIATED WITH PROVIDING INFORMATION IN RESPONSE TO THIS ANNOUNCEMENT OR ANY FOLLOW-UP INFORMATION REQUESTS. THIS IS A FOLLOW ON FOR A DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY (DHS) STRATEGIC SOURCING CONTRACT VEHICLE, TO BE AWARDED AND ADMINISTERED BY THE U. S. COAST GUARD. AT THIS TIME THE POTENTIAL NUMBER OF MULTIPLE AWARD IDIQ CONTRACTS TO BE PUT IN PLACE TO COVER THE AREA OF RESPONSIBILITY HAS NOT BEEN DETERMINED. The synopsis and any subsequent amendments will be available at no charge online at https://sam.gov. The successful offerors will provide professional engineering and environmental services to support USCG shore infrastructure, real property, and other projects. The scope of services includes support under the four key USCG environmental programs: Compliance Restoration and Liabilities Planning Stewardship and Training Services may be required at a variety of facilities, buildings, structures, and geographic areas, both onshore and offshore (e.g., bases, small boat stations, light stations, aids-to-navigation facilities, communications facilities). description: REQUEST FOR QUOTATION (RFQ) RFQ FA800326Q0012 1.0 GENERAL INFORMATION 1.1 Introduction, Background & Purpose. This Request for Quotation (RFQ) is a competitive action conducted on the open market as a Combined Synopsis/Solicitation in accordance with (IAW) Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 12, Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services. The Air Force Installation Contracting Center (AFICC) 771 ESS/EGA has a requirement for a comprehensive commercial audiovisual (AV) equipment lease/rental with incidental setup, teardown, and on-site technical standby support for the 2027 Nursing Practice Oversight Course (NPOC) Conference in support of Air Force Medical Command (AFMEDCOM). This requirement is a Total Small Business Set-Aside under North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code 532490 (Other Commercial and Industrial Machinery and Equipment Rental and Leasing) and Product Service Code (PSC) W099 (Lease or Rental of Equipment: Miscellaneous). Be aware: FAR Part 15 procedures do NOT apply to this acquisition. The Government is not establishing a competitive range, conducting formal "discussions," or requesting "Final Proposal Revisions" (FPRs). The Government intends to evaluate quotations and award a contract without engaging in communications with Quoters. Therefore, Quoters are highly encouraged to submit their best technical and pricing terms in their initial quotation. The Government intends to award a single, Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) contract utilizing a Lowest Price Technically Acceptable (LPTA) evaluation methodology. The Period of Performance (POP) is event-specific, running from 22 February 2027 through 24 February 2027. The event shall be held at Hotel Polaris, 8989 N Gate Blvd, Colorado Springs, CO 80921. 1.2 Government Points of Contact (POCs). The Contracting Officer (CO) and the Contract Specialist (CS) are the sole points of contact for this acquisition. All questions must be submitted by 4:00 PM on MONDAY, 26 OCTOBER 2026. Questions must be submitted using the Q&A Spreadsheet (Attachment 5) format. Responses will be posted directly to SAM.gov (www.sam.gov). Quotation Submission. Quotations must be submitted by 4:00 PM on MONDAY, 16 NOVEMBER 2026. Quotations received after this deadline will not be considered for award. 1.4 General Terms and Conditions. Compliance: The quotation must comply with the terms and conditions of this RFQ. Non-conformance may result in an unfavorable evaluation or the quotation being removed from consideration. Discrepancies: If a Quoter believes these instructions contain an error, omission, or ambiguity, they shall immediately notify the Government POCs via email with supporting rationale prior to the quotation deadline. description: The Congressionally Directed Medical Research Programs (CDMRP) seeks feedback to inform potential future Lupus Research Program (LRP) focus areas and associated research funding opportunities. title: C-130, C-17 and C-5 Solid State Cockpit Voice Recording (SSCVR) and Solid-State Flight Data Recorder (SSFDR) and Amplifier Control Unit (ACU)
description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation to announce that the Warner Robins Air Logistics Center (ALC), Robins AFB, GA, intends to solicit and negotiate on a competitive basis to procure the Amplifier Control Unit (ACU) and Solid-State Flight Data Recorder (SSFDR) for C-5, C-17, and C-130 aircraft. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; proposals are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. The Request for Quote (RFQ) number is FA8539-27-QB-002. This requirement contains the following National Stock Numbers (NSNs) and Part Numbers (P/Ns): Item Description National Stock Number (NSN) Part Number (P/N) Flight Data Recorder 6610-01-501-1161CX 2100-4042-53 Control Amplifier 5895-01-524-2752CX 93-A152-16B The issuing Contracting Office's DODAAC is FA8539; Address, AFSC/PZABA. The Government intends to award a one-year (12-month) Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) Purchase Order. The period of performance shall begin upon the date of award and extend through final delivery, inspection, and acceptance of all required items, not to exceed one (1) year from the date of award. This acquisition is unrestricted and conducted using full and open competition. Competition is not limited to the OEM. An offeror may be the OEM, an authorized distributor, a reseller, a surplus dealer, or another responsible source able to furnish the exact, unmodified part with acceptable condition documentation and complete traceability to the manufacturer or authorized supply chain. All responsible sources may submit an offer that the Government will consider. This solicitation does not commit the Government to award a contract or pay proposal-preparation costs. The Government may reject any or all offers, cancel the solicitation, or waive informalities and minor irregularities when permitted and in the Government�s interest. Only a warranted Contracting Officer may bind the Government. Interested parties may identify their interest by submitting a proposal via email, to the following Robins AFB personnel: Contracting Officer: Reid Sawyer, email: reid.sawyer@us.af.mil Program Manager: Anthony Simmons email: anthony.simmons.12@us.af.mil Parties may also submit a Statement of Capabilities if not interested in submitting a proposal for this requirement. OMBUDSMAN: All potential offeror(s) should contact the Contracting Officer identified above for additional information and/or to communicate concerns, if any, concerning this acquisition. If the Contracting Officer does not satisfy your concerns, an Ombudsman has been appointed to hear serious concerns that are not resolved through established channels. The purpose of the Ombudsman is not to diminish the authority of the Program Manager, Program Director or the Contracting Officer, but to communicate serious contractor concerns, issues, disagreements, and recommendations to the appropriate government personnel. When requested, the Ombudsman will maintain strict confidentiality as to the source of the concern. The Ombudsman does not participate in the evaluation of the proposals or in the source selection process. When appropriate, potential offeror(s) may contact the Ombudsman, Mrs. Nicole Furlough, via email, at nicole.furlough@us.af.mil. PLEASE DO NOT EMAIL THE OMBUDSMAN FOR SOLICITATION/INFORMATION REQUESTS.

title: Germany – Public road transport services – Vergabe von Personenbeförderungsleistungen im Linienverkehr mit Kraftfahrzeugen im Landkreis Böblingen, Verkehrsraum Linienbündel 2 "Strudelbach"
description: Der öffentliche Auftraggeber ist zuständiger Aufgabenträger im öffentlichen Personennahverkehr (ÖPNV) nach § 8 Abs. 3 Satz 1 PBefG i. V. m. § 6 Abs. 1 des Gesetzes über die Planung, Organisation und Gestaltung des öffentlichen Personennahverkehrs Baden-Württemberg (ÖPNVG BW). Der Auftraggeber ist gem. § 6 Abs. 3 ÖPNVG BW damit auch zuständige Behörde im Sinne der EU-Verordnung (EG) Nr. 1370/2007 (VO 1370/2007). Der Landkreis ist damit für die Sicherstellung eines ausreichenden Verkehrsangebots in seinem Wirkungskreis zuständig (§ 8 Abs. 3 PBefG). Nachdem die aktuelle Verkehrsbedienung im Linienbündel BB02 zum 30.06.2027 endet, war die Verkehrsleistung ab dem 01.07.2027 zu gewährleisten, mithin neu auszuschreiben. Zur Vergabe kommen die Busverkehrsleistungen auf den nachfolgenden aufgelisteten VVS-Linien: – Linie 634 Weissach - Flacht - Rutesheim - Leonberg – Linie 634A Weissach - Flacht - Perouse - Rutesheim (Schülerverkehr) – Linie N62 Leonberg - Gebersheim - Rutesheim - Perouse - Flacht - Weissach und zurück Es handelt sich ausschließlich um Linienverkehre die nach § 42 PBefG genehmigt werden sollen. Der Auftragnehmer hat den vorgegebenen Fahrplan zu erfüllen; dieser ist in Anhang LB.1 beigefügt. In Anhang LB.2 und Anhang LB.3 finden sich die zugehörigen Planungshilfen. Im Rahmen der Inbetriebnahme des Eisenbahninfrastrukturprojektes Stuttgart 21 (S21) kann es zu Verschiebungen im S-Bahn- und/ oder Regionalverkehr kommen. Die Deutsche Bahn hat im Juni 2026 eine stufenweise Inbetriebnahme ab vrsl. Dezember 2031 angekündigt. Daher sind die vorgegebenen Busfahrpläne nach Umstellung der S-Bahn- und/oder Regionalverkehre durch den Auftragnehmer auf Kompatibilität mit den dann geltenden S-Bahn- und/ oder Regionalverkehrsfahrplänen zu überprüfen. Mögliche Anpassungen sind mit dem Aufgabenträger und ggf. dem VVS rechtzeitig abzustimmen und umzusetzen. Das Letztentscheidungsrecht hat der Aufgabenträger. Der Auftraggeber stellt klar, dass es sich bei dem beschriebenen Mechanismus um Optionen im Sinne des § 132 Abs. 2 S. 1 Nr. 1 GWB handelt, welche im Falle einer, auch späteren, Inbetriebnahme von S 21 eine Auftragsänderung ohne Neuausschreibung ermöglichen. Die Auftragsvergabe fällt in den Anwendungsbereich der Richtlinie 2009/33/EG des Europäischen Parlaments und des Rates (Richtlinie zur Förderung sauberer Fahrzeuge — CVD). Näheres ist Ziff. 5.1. zu entnehmen.

title: Core Research Program Technology Transfer & Commercialization Advancement
description: The Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration (PHMSA) Research and Development (R&D) Core Research Program announces this competitive solicitation for proposals focused strictly on Technology Transfer (T2) and Commercialization Advancement. The core objective of this Research Announcement is to accelerate the transition of high-impact pipeline safety innovations from advanced laboratory and operational prototypes to full-scale commercial deployment and operational field implementation across the Nation's energy transportation infrastructure. This solicitation specifically targets mature technologies at high Technology Readiness Levels (TRL 7�9) to bridge the critical 'implementation gap' by resolving final technical, regulatory, operational, credentialing, and market hurdles. Funding will only be awarded for projects that demonstrate a clear, definitive path to producing deployable technology, commercial products, or integrated service system ready for immediate market availability and pipeline operator adoption upon project completion.

title: Předběžná tržní konzultace k VZ: "Dodávka detektorů chemických látek"
description: Předběžná tržní konzultace (PTK) k VZ: "Dodávka detektorů chemických látek", jejímž cílem je zjištění okruhu potenciálních dodavatelů a získání informací od dodavatelů působících na relevantním trhu pro správné nastavení zadávacích podmínek. Zadavatel má zájem, aby zadávací podmínky co nejlépe odpovídaly jeho potřebám a současně, aby byly i spolu s předmětem zakázky nastaveny v souladu se zákonem č. 134/2016 Sb., o zadávání veřejných zakázek, ve znění pozdějších předpisů (dále také jen „ZZVZ“). Zadavatel realizací předběžné tržní konzultace hodlá předcházet možným rizikům, která by se při zadávání veřejné zakázky a jejím následném plnění mohla vyskytnout. Zadavatel chce v rámci předběžné tržní konzultace získat informace o možnostech relevantního trhu tak, aby mohl optimálně nastavit zadávací podmínky veřejné zakázky, resp. celého zadávacího řízení na dodávku detektorů chemických látek. Předpokládaná hodnota veřejné zakázky dosud není známa. V případě Vašeho zájmu o účast na této předběžné tržní konzultaci prosím zašlete své odpovědi na dotazy uvedené v příloze č. 1 pozvánky PTK na e-mailovou adresu zástupce zadavatele: zakazky@matznervitek.cz Svoji odpověď prosím doručte nejpozději do pondělí 16. 11. 2026, 23:59 hod.

buyer: Stadt Lörrach - Fachbereich Stadtentwicklung und Stadtplanung
title: Offener zweiphasiger städtebaulich-freiraumplanerischer Realisierungswettbewerb als vorgeschalteter Planungswettbewerb für eine Vergabe im Verhandlungsverfahren nach VgV "Zukunft Krankenhaus-Areal Lörrach"
description: In absehbarer Zukunft werden die Kreiskliniken des Landkreises Lörrach und das St.Elisabethen-Krankenhaus im neuen Zentralklinikum Lörrach (Dreiland-Klinikum- Lörrach), im Nordosten der Stadt vereint. In diesem Zusammenhang wird auch der Standort des Kreiskrankenhauses in Lörrach aufgegeben. Das ca. 3,5 ha große innenstadtnahe Areal zwischen der Röntgenstraße im Süden, der Spitalstraße im Osten, der Körnerstraße im Norden und dem Gewerbekanal „Neuer Teich“ im Westen, wird an die Stadt Lörrach zurückfallen und für eine Folgenutzung frei. Das Krankenhaus-Areal ist einer der wichtigen Transformationsorte der Stadt und im Kontext mit der Weiterentwicklung der Gesamtstadt zu sehen. Die Entwicklung des Areals soll dementsprechend im Kontext der Stärkung Lörrachs als urbane und lebenswerte Stadt in der Region verstanden werden. Ziel ist es, mutige, innovative und unkonventionelle Entwurfsansätze zu entwickeln, die den gegenwärtigen Städtebau hinterfragen und eine auf Lörrach zugeschnittene neue Urbanität schaffen, die Klimaanpassung mit Nutzungsmischung, soziale Teilhabe und Mehrgenerationenfähigkeit konsequent und resilient umsetzt. Das künftige Areal soll unter möglicher Berücksichtigung des Teilerhalts vorhandener Strukturen und der Umnutzung einiger potenzieller Gebäudeteile als urbanes Quartier neu überplant werden. Ziel ist es, ein zukunftsfähiges Quartier zu schaffen und zusätzlich eine Perspektive für die Weiterentwicklung der unmittelbaren Umgebung und angrenzender Gebiete vor-zubereiten. Die städtebauliche und freiraumplanerische Transformation des Areals, in Etappen und langfristig, ermöglicht ein innenstadtnahes durchmischtes Quartier mit dem Schwerpunkt auf Wohnen und Nutzungen der Gesundheitsvorsorge, Erholung sowie sozialer und gewerblicher Infrastruktur und vereint eine angemessene zukunftsorientiere Dichte mit innerstädtischen Freiräumen und Klimaanpassung. Wettbewerbsgegenstand: Städtebaulich-freiraumplanerische Vorentwurfsplanung (Leistungsphase 2) für das künftige urbane Quartier in Lörrach. Wettbewerbsverfahren: Offener zweiphasiger städtebaulich-freiraumplanerischer Realisierungswettbewerb gemäß der RPW 2013, mit anschließendem Verhandlungsverfahren nach der VgV. Die Beurteilung und Auswahl der Teilnehmer*innen in der ersten Phase, die für die Bearbeitung des städtebaulich-freiraumplanerischen Realisierungswettbewerb (2. Phase) zugelassen werden, erfolgt anhand einer „Kreativaufgabe“ durch das Preisgericht. Der Wettbewerb wird im Rahmen der VgV 2016, i.V.m. § 3 Abs. 3 RPW 2013 durchgeführt und ist anonym (gemäß § 1 Abs. 4 der RPW 2013). Im Anschluss an das Wettbewerbsverfahren, nach Abschluss der 2. Phase, werden gemäß § 14 Abs. 4 Ziff. 8 VgV die Preisträger*innen zu Vergabeverhandlungsgesprächen eingeladen. Beauftragung: Die Ausloberin wird, unter Würdigung der Empfehlungen des Preisgerichts, eine*n der Preisträger*innen (§ 8 Abs. 2 RPW 2013) mit der Leistungsphase 3 des städtebaulichen Entwurfs und der Leistungsphase 3 des freiräumlichen Entwurfs beauftragen. Gemäß der Vergaberichtlinien nach VgV sind mit allen Preisträger*innen Verhandlungsgespräche zu führen. Rechtsgrundlage: Richtlinien 2014/24/EU VgV - Verordnung über die Vergabe öffentlicher Aufträge - Deutsch RPW 2013 - Richtlinie für Planungswettbewerbe - Deutsch Teilnahmeberechtigt sind: Natürliche Personen, die gemäß Rechtsvorschrift ihres Heimatlandes am Tag der Bekanntmachung zur Führung einer der folgenden Berufsbezeichnungen berechtigt sind (Richtlinie 2005/36/EG Berufsanerkennungsrichtlinie): Stadtplaner*in, Landschaftsarchitekt*in, Architekt*in. Interdisziplinäre Bewerber*innen oder interdisziplinäre Bewerbergemeinschaften, die die fachlichen Voraussetzungen erfüllen. Fachliche Voraussetzungen sind die Berechtigungen zur Führung der folgenden Berufsbezeichnungen gemäß Rechtsvorschrift des Herkunftsstaates: Stadtplaner*in, Landschaftsarchitekt*in, Architekt*in. Erfüllt ein*e Bewerber*in die fachliche Voraussetzung allein oder zusammen mit fest angestellten Mitarbeitern*innen ist er*sie allein teilnahmeberechtigt. (Der*die Mitarbeiter*in / die Mitarbeiter*innen ist / sind in der Verfassererklärung explizit zu nennen.) Bei juristischen Personen sind die fachlichen Anforderungen erfüllt, wenn der satzungsgemäße Geschäftszweck Planungsleistungen sind, die der Wettbewerbsaufgabe entsprechen. Außerdem muss der*die zu benennende bevollmächtigte Vertreter*in und der oder die Verfasser*innen der Wettbewerbsarbeit insgesamt die oben genannte fachliche Anforderung erfüllen. Ist in dem Herkunftsstaat die Berufsbezeichnung nicht gesetzlich geregelt, so erfüllt die entsprechende fachliche Anforderung, wer über ein Diplom, Prüfungszeugnis oder sonstigen Befähigungsnachweis verfügt, dessen Anerkennung gemäß der Richtlinie 2013/55/EU- „Berufsanerkennungsrichtlinie“ - gewährleistet ist. Mehrfachbeteiligungen natürlicher oder juristischer Personen oder von Mitgliedern von Bewerbergemeinschaften führen zum Ausschluss der Beteiligten. Teilnahmehindernisse sind in § 4 Abs. 2 RPW beschrieben. Sachverständige, Fachplaner*innen, Berater*innen müssen die Teilnahmebedingungen nicht erfüllen. Benennung Landschaftsarchitekt*in: Die Benennung des*der Landschaftsarchitekt*in muss bis zum Ende der Frist zur 1. Phase erfolgt sein (16.11.2026, 23:59 Uhr). Frist zur Einreichung der Bewerbung zur Teilnahme: 16.11.2026, 23:59 Uhr. title: EU-udbud af 4 stk. fabriksnye og færdigopbyggede lastbiler til Indsamling i Nordværk I/S
description: Udbuddet omfatter indkøb af 4 stk. fabriksnye og færdigopbyggede lastbiler til Indsamling i Nordværk I/S. Udbuddet fordeler sig på 3 delaftaler, jf. nedenstående: Delaftale 1 - 2 stk. fabriksny 4-akslet EL-drevet renovationsbil færdigopbygget som trækker og trailer, med komprimator og kran til tømning af nedgravede containere - Restaffald. Delaftale 2 - 1 stk. fabriksny 4-akslet EL-drevet renovationsbil færdigopbygget som trækker og trailer, med komprimator og kran/kædetræk til tømning af nedgravede containere – Papir/pap-affald. Delaftale 3 - 1 stk. fabriksny 4-akslet HVO-dieseldrevet renovationsbil færdigopbygget som trækker og trailer, med kran/kædetræk (wiretræk) og krogløsning til tømning af nedgravede containere - Glasaffald. Nordværk vil indgå kontrakt med én leverandør pr. delaftale, der herefter skal varetage levering af de(n) fabriksny- og færdigopbygget lastbil(er) omfattet af aftalen.

buyer: BEW Berliner Energie und Wärme GmbH
title: Germany – Construction work – DSP - Pumpenhaus Scharnhorststraße Dezentral
description: Das Projekt DSP – Dezentral Scharnhorststraße Pumpenhaus ist eine Infrastrukturmaßnahme zur Erweiterung und Modernisierung des Heizwerks Scharnhorststraße. Am Standort Scharnhorststraße wird eine neue Wärmeübertragerstation mit zwei Pumpengruppen, Rohrleitungssystemen sowie den erforderlichen elektro- und leittechnischen Einrichtungen in einer „Brownfield-Umgebung“ errichtet. Die Umsetzung erfolgt innerhalb eines bestehenden Heizwerksstandortes in einer Brownfield-Umgebung. Neben der Errichtung neuer Anlagenkomponenten sind zahlreiche Schnittstellen zu bestehenden Anlagen, Rohrleitungssystemen, elektro- und leittechnischen Einrichtungen sowie betrieblichen Prozessen zu berücksichtigen. Besonderes Augenmerk liegt dabei auf der Aufrechterhaltung der Versorgungssicherheit und die Umsetzung aller relevanten Umschlussarbeiten innerhalb eines drei (3) monatigen Stillstandsfensters. Für die Umsetzung des Projektes werden in einem vorgelagerten Projekt bereits die erforderlichen Voraussetzungen zur Baufeldfreimachung geschaffen. Aufbauend darauf umfasst das Projekt DSP die Ausführungsplanung, Beschaffung, Errichtung, Inbetriebsetzung und Übergabe der neuen Anlagentechnik einschließlich aller hierfür erforderlichen Nebenleistungen. Auszuführende Arbeiten: • Montage und Umbau von Fernwärme-Anlagenkomponenten • Installation und Integration von Pumpensystemen mit elektrischer Antriebstechnik • Rohrleitungsbau für Fernwärmeanwendungen einschließlich Verbindung und Einbindung von Anlagenteilen (Nennweiten ca. DN 200 bis DN 600) • Anbindung neuer Rohrleitungen und Komponenten an bestehende Versorgungs- und Rohrleitungssysteme • Lieferung und Montage von Armaturen, Regel- und Absperreinrichtungen (Nennweiten ca. DN 250 bis DN 600) • Planung und Errichtung von Rohrleitungsbefestigungen sowie unterstützenden Stahlbaukonstruktionen • Einbindung bestehender Anlagenkomponenten in neu errichtete Systeme • Herstellung von Fundamenten für Anlagen- und Stahlbaukomponenten • Anpassung und Erweiterung von Niederspannungs-, Energieversorgungs- und Antriebssystemen • Anpassung und Erweiterung von Mess-, Steuerungs- und Leittechnik • Erneuerung elektrischer Energieversorgungsanlagen einschließlich Kabelverlegung • Demontage und Rückbau bestehender Anlagen- und Rohrleitungskomponenten (Nennweiten bis ca. DN 500) Die Anbindungen an das Netz erfolgen auf dem Betriebsgelände. Die oberirdische Zuführung der beiden DN500 Leitungen auf dem Betriebsgelände auf einem bestehenden Stahlbau gehört zum Projektumfang. Die vorhandene und zu erweiternde Leittechnik ist auf dem Betriebsgebäude verortet. Die Planung der E- und Leittechnik sind Bestandteil vom Projektumfang. Schnittstellen zur bestehenden E- und Leittechnik sind vorhanden und zu berücksichtigen.

title: Germany – Urban environmental development planning – 10012255-Short Term Expert Support on Sustainable and Inclusive Mobility in Colombia
description: ProMOVIS II, implemented by the Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH on behalf of the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ), supports Colombian cities in strengthening their capacities to deliver public transport systems that better serve their populations. Colombia has committed to ambitious climate targets under its Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs), requiring a 51% reduction in projected emissions by 2030. The transport sector accounts for approximately 45% of energy related GHG emissions nationwide, making the decarbonization of urban transport one of the country's most impactful mitigation opportunities. Despite ongoing efforts, the integration of public transport systems at local and regional levels remains insufficient, affected by the lasting effects of the pandemic, financing gaps, low digitalization, and early stage regional integration, particularly critical in metropolitan regions with high intermunicipal commuting, such as Valle del Cauca. Within this context, ProMOVIS II concentrates technical cooperation efforts on strengthening public transportation, incorporating a regional integration perspective and initially focusing its actions on Valle del Cauca. The objective is that public transport in selected Colombian cities is more integrated, inclusive and environmentally friendly, pursued through three outcomes: (1) number of people benefiting from newly created or improved public transport; (2) funds secured by selected cities to finance environmentally friendly, integrated public transport projects; and (3) number of bus operators and transport authorities that assess that professionals trained in green jobs training formats contribute positively to integrated, inclusive and environmentally friendly public transport. Through technical assistance, financing-related support, and knowledge exchange, ProMOVIS II addresses the institutional, organizational and operational challenges that limit the effective integration and sustainability of public transport systems, working closely with national and local governments, transport authorities and other stakeholders to strengthen local capacities and develop solutions that are replicable, scalable and sustainable over time.

description: Die Stadt Löhne beabsichtigt den Umbau des Empfangsgebäudes des Bahnhofs Löhne zu einem "Dritten Ort". Das in Teilen Denkmal geschützte Empfangsgebäude des Bahnhofs Löhne wurde in den Jahren 1913 ff. errichtet. Es handelt sich um einen großen, aus mehreren Bauteilen zusammengesetzten Baukörper mit zentraler Empfangshalle, an die ein zweigeschossiger Ostflügel und ein ebenfalls zweigeschossiger Westflügel angrenzen, in denen ehemalige Diensträume, Wartesäle verschiedener Klassen, Räume für Post, Zoll und Polizei sowie Wohnräume des Vorstehers untergebracht waren. Die Bereiche der ehemaligen Wartesäle und des Westflügels sind unterkellert. Das Gebäude wurde in dunkelrotem Backstein errichtet, die einzelnen Bauteile sind mit Walm- und Satteldächern versehen. Die Fassaden sind durch Lisenen und Gesimse zurückhaltend gegliedert. Besonders hervorgehoben ist die Giebelseite mit dem Haupteingang durch Verwendung dekorativer Bachsteinverbände sowie ein lebhaft gestaltetes Giebelgesims. Im Zuge dieses Bauvorhabens wird das Bahnhofsgebäude grundlegend saniert, umgebaut und erweitert.

title: Belgium – Plumbing and heating materials – Marché à bons de commandes - fournitures sanitaires et chauffage
description: Objet des fournitures : Accord-cadre multi-attributaires pour la fourniture de matériels de plomberie, chauffage et sanitaire. Commentaire : Le présent marché a pour objet la conclusion d’un accord-cadre multi-attributaires pour la fourniture de matériels nécessaires aux interventions de la régie technique de la société de logement de service public. Les fournitures comprennent des accessoires et produits de plomberie, sanitaires et de chauffage. Il s'agit d’un marché public de fournitures. Le marché est conclu sous la forme d’un accord-cadre avec un maximum de trois attributaires, pour une durée de quatre ans. Les commandes seront exécutées selon un système en cascade. L’adjudicataire ne livre pas l’ensemble des fournitures en une fois, mais par livraisons fractionnées sur base de bons de commandes successifs au gré des besoins du pouvoir adjudicateur, pendant toute la durée du marché. Le marché porte sur la totalité des produits repris dans l’inventaire ci-joint ET du catalogue du soumissionnaire, dont les articles font partie de l’objet du présent marché. Par conséquent, le pouvoir adjudicateur aura accès au catalogue de l’adjudicataire moyennant une remise. Le pouvoir adjudicateur disposera d’un compte client, permettant le suivi des commandes, suivi des livraisons, accès aux fiches techniques du matériel et état du stock. Le soumissionnaire fournira, avec son offre, un compte client temporaire pour que l’adjudicateur puisse tester l’interface du catalogue en ligne. Au moment de la rédaction des conditions du présent marché, l’administration n’est pas en mesure de définir avec précision les quantités de fournitures dont elle aura besoin. En conséquence, les quantités présumées indiquées dans le présent cahier spécial des charges régissant le présent marché sont à titre purement indicatif et elles n’engagent nullement l’administration. Le marché est attribué au(x) soumissionnaire(s) dont l’offre est régulière et économiquement la plus avantageuse. Le classement établi lors de l’analyse des offres déterminera l’ordre de recours aux fournisseurs dans le cadre d'un système en cascade. Les commandes sont d’abord adressées au fournisseur le mieux classé. En cas d’indisponibilité d’un article ou de délai de livraison non respecté, la commande est passée au fournisseur suivant dans le classement. L’indisponibilité devra être confirmée par écrit par le fournisseur concerné dans un délai de 24h ouvrables. Les fournitures seront livrées au siège de la slsp. Le délai standard de livraison doit être indiqué et ne pourra excéder 48 heures ouvrables sauf exception. La livraison s’effectue sur base de bon de commande signé. Une vérification qualitative et quantitative sera effectuée à la réception. Le marché peut être reconduit tacitement 3 fois. Lieu de livraison : 5503 Sorinnes rue du Saxophone 97 (ou, à titre exceptionnel, directement au sein du patrimoine de la slsp)

title: Request for Information _ Creation of The United States Space Academy
description: On Aug. 28, 2026, President Donald J. Trump issued Executive Order (E.O.) 14423, Establishing the United States Space Academy. To answer that call, the United States Space Academy (USSA) is envisioned as a NASA-led, civilian Federal academic institution that combines rigorous technical education with disciplined leadership development, civic responsibility, and a lasting commitment to public service. The Academy will prepare future scientists, engineers, astronauts, pilots, operators, entrepreneurs, civil servants, warfighters, and other leaders to advance American interests across the aerospace sector. Through this Request for Information (RFI), NASA invites each State to submit one official State-sponsored response prepared by a �Responding Entity� and coordinated and formally endorsed by a State Selecting Official. The Governor must designate both the Responding Entity and the State Selecting Official in writing. The response should provide information to support NASA�s assessment of potential locations and operating solutions for the United States Space Academy (USSA). That assessment will inform NASA�s recommendation to the Commission. NASA�s objectives for this announcement are to: Identify potential locations for the permanent establishment of the USSA campus, including a groundbreaking no later than 2027. Identify interim solutions that may allow the USSA to begin instruction in 2028 and facilitate a smooth transition to a permanent campus by 2031. Explore the estimated costs of establishing the USSA and potential state, local, and other non-Federal partnerships that could support its establishment. Information obtained through this RFI will be used by NASA and the Commission to develop the recommended process for selecting the Academy�s permanent physical location, which will be reported to the President for decision. A separate announcement for formal proposals may be issued at a later date. UPDATES MADE AS OF 10.2.26: Question and Answers Document attached. UPDATES MADE AS OF 10.7.26: Updated Question and Answers Document attached. UPDATES MADE AS OF 10.9.26: RFI extended until November 16, 2026.
